investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pineis Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus (zones eastus-1/eastus-2/eastus-3); network range 10.53.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pineis-prod-eastus (AKS); Edge tier: app-frontend proxies API calls to backend services using per-upstream timeouts from its configuration file; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
